name: AutoBattler
description: v2.7.0: unified opportunity planning (fourth play-test feedback) -- the v2.6 bounty/goal layers are replaced by one value-vs-route-risk planner: explicit values for special targets (boss/elite 30, spawner egg 40, cursed/evolved 18, x --arb-bounty), route damage estimated from the same threat model with allowed risk = value*(0.10+0.20*agg)+2*agg and HP floors 0.55/0.35/0.20, a 100-frame commitment with value-scaled pull (clamp(10+0.6*value,14,34) for targets, x1-2 for rewards) and a close-in candidate. world_view gathers special targets out to 900/1400/1600 px by --arb-agg (nearest 8 extras) and gives fleeing loot aliens a measured velocity (6th reward field, value 8) that the arbiter intercepts with two fixed-point iterations. Opt-outs: --arb-opp (0 = exact v2.6.1) and --arb-agg (risk dial, inert while opp=0); all 13 switches at 0 = exact v2.4.0. v2.6.1: contact-avoidance fix (third play-test feedback) -- the bot no longer drifts into a monster and orbits it: the crowding terms projected a chasing body with its frozen velocity and could price running away as MORE crowded than orbiting, so the bot held a stable orbit on top of one chaser taking contact hits; the projection now tracks outrunnable pursuers (--arb-roomtrack=0 rolls back). Also: a winding-up charger's frozen body is now priced (--arb-windup=0), and the contact reach can no longer under-estimate elites/bosses/DLC non-circle hitboxes (--arb-hitbox=0). Movement-only autopilot for Brotato (MIT fork of BOTato, tested on 1.2.0.1). Auto-moves/dodges/collects during waves; every decision stays manual. Behaviour priors are inferred from measured build traits (no per-character table needed). v2.6.0: space planning — retreats from the wall band before a crowd squeezes it shut, a weak open-floor potential against edge drift; bounty approach toward special targets (bosses/elites, spawner eggs, cursed/evolved); item crates priced as items and loot aliens worth a detour. v2.5.0: planning layer — pre-emptive breakout from a closing encirclement (future-freedom rollout + committed escape), committed high-value item goals (DLC evolution fruits, hurt fruit, trees) with a walk-on pickup fix and end-of-wave urgency; pursuit-aware second ply. All new behaviour has exact opt-out flags. v2.4.0: DLC-aware engage stances for cursed/evolved enemies + evolution item pickup. v2.3.0: ranged standoff, trees/hurt fruit, 2-ply planner + hit-adaptive caution. Toggle with Shift+Space.
